status.failed: The call ended with an error.
status.waiting: Waiting for another session to call the routine…
status.target_finished: The call in session {{pid}} has ended. Its result is that session's.

indirect.title: Set breakpoint
indirect.help: A global breakpoint is set on the routine: the next call any session makes (an application, a statement that fires the trigger) stops here and is debugged on this page. The other session waits meanwhile; Stop aborts its statement.
indirect.superuser: You must be a superuser to set a global breakpoint and perform indirect debugging.
